issues.description: setuptools<82 pin leaks into core runtime install_requires, not just CI
issues.detail: The CI break is in mmcv build. Putting `setuptools<82` into core/setup.py extras forces every downstream user installing this extra to take an outdated setuptools forever. The fix belongs in the CI scripts (already done) or as a build-time constraint, not as a runtime dependency. Scope creep: one patch doing two unrelated things.

issues.description: mmdet bumped from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 with no justification in the diff
issues.detail: Commit message says "Fix mmengine failure." The diff also bumps mmdet 3.2.0 to 3.3.0. That is a separate change. If mmdet 3.3.0 is required by mmengine 0.10.7 or mmcv 2.1.0, say so. Otherwise split it. THREE-PATCHES.

With `--no-build-isolation`, mmcv uses the environment's setuptools, so the pin matters. Fine. But build_pkg in env_setup.sh already pins it for builds, and core/setup.py now pins it at runtime. Three pins for one constraint. Pick one source of truth and reference the FIXME from there.

issues.description: FIXME tracking issue is upstream; no internal owner or revert criterion
issues.detail: Both FIXMEs point at open-mmlab/mmcv#3325. Fine for context, but there is no internal owner, no revert PR linked, and no test that fails once the cap can be lifted. The maintainer six months from now will not know when it is safe to remove. Add a tracking issue in this repo.

review.summary: Pragmatic CI fix: pin setuptools<82 so mmcv build doesn't trip over pkg_resources removal, and install mmengine from PyPI instead of a pinned git SHA. The CI script changes are the right shape. The problem is scope: setuptools<82 leaks into core/setup.py as a runtime install_requires for an unrelated CI build problem, and mmdet gets bumped from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 with no mention in the commit message. NEEDS-WORK: justify or split the mmdet bump, and move the setuptools cap out of core runtime deps. Land the env_setup.sh and setup_mmcv.sh changes as-is.
